description.text: Objectives The Master of Science program in Applied Mathematics is designed for people who wish to work independently in teaching and research in math related fields. The program provides solid theory and systematic research skills in the areas of applied mathematics. We encourage our students to be systematic, professionally ethical, and internationally competent. Duration Duration of program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Differential Equations Theory and Application 2. Numerical Analysis and Scientific Computing 3. Time Series Analysis 4. Financial Mathematics Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 32 credits. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Applied Mathematics at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
